pdf.name: PDF Tools
pdf.caption: Merge, split, secure, convert — documents never leave your machine.

media.name: Media Tools
media.caption: Download, convert, compress, and transcribe video and audio.

image.name: Image Tools
image.caption: Convert, compress, resize, and clean up images — fully offline.

devtext.name: Text & Dev Tools
devtext.caption: The everyday utility belt for text, code, and data.

ui.placeholderNote: This tool ships in a later build phase. The design system, navigation, and registry are already in place — the implementation arrives with its suite.

merge-pdf.name: Merge PDF
merge-pdf.description: Combine multiple PDFs into one document.

split-pdf.name: Split PDF
split-pdf.description: Split by page range, every N pages, or file size.

extract-pages.name: Extract Pages
extract-pages.description: Pull selected pages out into a new PDF.

delete-pages.name: Delete Pages
delete-pages.description: Remove pages from a PDF permanently.

crop-pages.name: Crop Pages
crop-pages.description: Trim margins or crop to a region.

watermark.name: Add Watermark
watermark.description: Overlay text or an image across pages.

pdf-to-image.name: PDF to JPG/PNG
pdf-to-image.description: Render each page as an image.

image-to-pdf.name: JPG/PNG to PDF
image-to-pdf.description: Bundle images into a PDF document.

scan-to-pdf.name: Scan to PDF
scan-to-pdf.description: Capture with your camera into a PDF.

sign-pdf.name: Sign PDF
sign-pdf.description: Draw, type, or place a visual signature.

redact-pdf.name: Redact PDF
redact-pdf.description: Genuinely remove hidden content, not just cover it.

compare-pdfs.name: Compare PDFs
compare-pdfs.description: Visual and text diff between versions.

quick-compress.name: Quick Compress
quick-compress.description: Shrink file size in your browser.

fill-forms.name: Fill & Flatten Forms
fill-forms.description: Complete AcroForms and flatten the result.

bookmarks-toc.name: Bookmarks / TOC Editor
bookmarks-toc.description: Edit the outline and table of contents.

resize-pages.name: Resize Page Dimensions
resize-pages.description: Scale pages to another paper size.

grayscale-pdf.name: Grayscale

pdf-to-text.name: PDF to Text/Markdown

powerpoint-conversion.name: PDF ↔ PowerPoint
powerpoint-conversion.description: Slide conversion via the local helper.

html-to-pdf.name: HTML to PDF
html-to-pdf.description: Render web pages and markup to PDF.

universal-downloader.name: Universal Downloader
universal-downloader.description: Save video/audio from supported sites via yt-dlp.

video-converter.name: Video Converter

extract-audio.name: Extract Audio
extract-audio.description: Pull the audio track out of a video.

audio-converter.name: Audio Converter

audio-trimmer.name: Audio Trimmer
audio-trimmer.description: Cut audio files to a range.

resolution-changer.name: Resolution / Aspect Changer

pdf-to-audiobook.name: PDF to Audiobook
pdf-to-audiobook.description: Documents read aloud, chapter by chapter.

image-resizer.name: Resizer
image-resizer.description: Exact size, percentage, or max bounds.

batch-image-processing.name: Batch Processing
batch-image-processing.description: Convert/compress a whole folder at once.

screenshot-annotator.name: Screenshot Annotator
screenshot-annotator.description: Crop, mark up, blur sensitive regions.

exif-inspector.name: EXIF Viewer / Stripper

image-ocr.name: Image to Text (OCR)

csv-json.name: CSV ↔ JSON
